notes.title: Ver. 1.01 Update Release Announcement
notes.content:
To all players,

Thank you very much for playing CINERIS SOMNIA!

We've just released the ver. 1.01 update, which includes adjustments and fixes based on all the feedback and requests we've received from players, including a boost in movement speed.

[b]●Game adjustments[/b]
[list]
[*] Character running speed has been increased, and adjustments have been made in accordance for parts of gameplay which are affected by movement speed.
[*] The default movement style has been set to "Run".
*Movement style can be changed from the title screen, or in-game via "Options".
[/list]

[b]●Bug fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed bug preventing the character's hair from sometimes (rarely) being properly rendered in the prologue.
[*] Fixed bug causing unnecessary stacking in the scene with building blocks.
[/list]

We hope you continue to enjoy CINERIS SOMNIA!

notes.title: CINERIS SOMNIA Out Now!
notes.content:
Hi All

We are excited to announce that CINERIS SOMNIA is out now! 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33615027/b085eb8fef9378e8397a4a0289705de75d0685c6.jpg[/img]

CINERIS SOMNIA is a 3D exploration-style adventure game, which explores a beautifully strange world as it takes a deeper look into the concepts of purity, ugliness, joy and anxiety – some of the complex and constantly moving parts that make up the human psyche.
The story progresses as you gradually unravel the mysteries and puzzles found at various points along the way.

Dive into a variety of stories as they each explore a different mystical world, and lead to a conclusion beyond your thoughts and emotions.  

https://youtu.be/d3yUB9DMk8Y 

[h1]Story[/h1]
A young girl awakens on the seashore.

All that remain are her sister’s yellow bucket and the sand castle they had just made together.
Her mother and sister are nowhere to be seen.

Blinded by the dazzling sunlight, the young girl takes her first step on a strange, mysterious journey...


[h1]Features:[/h1]
[list][*]A stunningly rendered ephemeral world.
[*]Haunting piano melodies to elevate the story.
[*]Multiple stories, all spurring the mystery on.
[*]Partially voiced in Japanese, adding more to the immersion of the game.
[*]An exploration into some of the more complex parts of the human psyche.[/list]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/752470/CINERIS_SOMNIA/
